title: Default stack
body:
Use this stack by default for a new app, so the user never has to repeat it:

**Build and UI**
- ✅ **Vite** — dev server and build
- ✅ **React 18** — UI
- ✅ **TypeScript**
- ✅ **TailwindCSS 4** — styling

**Desktop**
- ✅ **Electron** + **electron-builder**

**Data**
- ✅ **better-sqlite3** — local (default)
- ✅ **Supabase** — cloud (sync / auth / storage)

If the user asks for a different stack on a specific project, follow that request for that project only.

title: Project kickoff
body:
Before writing any code:
1. **Decide the app type** (desktop / web / tool) and confirm it with the user.
2. Scaffold with the default stack above.
3. If it needs cloud, auth or cross-device sync, set up **Supabase** first; otherwise stay on local SQLite.
4. Write a project note in CORTEX (spec + status) and keep it updated as you work.

title: Team workflow
body:
Fixed roles on this team:
- **Planner** — plans, writes tasks, does the final review.
- **Implementer** — writes the code.
- **Reviewer** — an extra pair of eyes.

Any agent that takes a task: move it to IN PROGRESS, log the start with `cortex_log`, write the output as a note, then move it to REVIEW. Always keep the board current so everyone can follow along.

title: Scaffold a new desktop app
body:
Steps for an Electron + React + TS + Tailwind 4 app:
1. `package.json` with `"type":"module"`, plus vite, @vitejs/plugin-react and @tailwindcss/vite.
2. `electron/main.ts` + `preload.ts` bundled to CJS with esbuild (external: electron and the native modules only).
3. `src/` for the UI (Vite on 5173 in dev), building into `dist/`.
4. `electron-builder.yml` for a DMG, with `asarUnpack` for native modules (`**/*.node`).
5. Scripts: `dev` (concurrently), `app` (build + electron), `dist` (build + electron-builder).

title: Set up Supabase
body:
When a project needs the cloud:
1. Create a Supabase project and get the `URL` and `anon key`.
2. Keep the keys in environment variables, never in the code.
3. Use `@supabase/supabase-js` for auth, database and storage.
4. For local-first apps keep SQLite as the source of truth and treat Supabase as a sync/backup layer, not the other way around.
5. Enable Row Level Security on every table before shipping.
